title: Una región unida
goal: Read a closing assessment of Latin American integration -- a fragmented map and lasting institutions, against still-modest intra-regional trade and Bolívar's still-unrealized dream, plus the roads, pipelines and power links meant to unite peoples.

items: Describe the fragmented map of regional integration.
State how large trade among Latin American countries was compared with their total trade.
Explain why the region's institutional achievements should not be underestimated.
Describe the roads, pipelines and power links meant to unite the peoples.
Use con todo to qualify a conclusion without fully reversing it.
